core_idea: Lobotomy E.G.O::Hornet【Alteration】 Meursault is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist / Support — **SP to gain 3 Spore Round — Base — / Spore Round — Base — / Spore Round — Buckshot —** damage carry who applies **Burn** on hits, spending ammo for burst on S3. Scaling conditions: Coin Power +1 per 6 (Burn + Bleed) (max +2); Coin Power +1 per 6 (Burn + Bleed) (max +3). Support passive (**Worker Bee**) applies when allies **land hits**. **SP regenerator** — restores ally **SP** through passives and key skills.
playstyle_guide:
- **Worker Bee** triggers **On Hit** — allies need to attack for the passive to apply.
- Apply Fragile or typed Fragility on the setup turn; coordinate team burst on the next turn.
- **SP sustain** fires at **Turn End** — restores **teammates**.
- Low-SP allies are topped up after clashes — let them spend freely, then rely on Turn End healing.
- Manage **SP to gain 3 Spore Round — Base — / Spore Round — Base — / Spore Round — Buckshot —** — multiple skills spend limited ammo on coin flips. Preserve **SP to gain 3 Spore Round — Base — / Spore Round — Base — / Spore Round — Buckshot —** for S3; when reserves are low, skip or pass on weaker S1, S2 so your strongest skill keeps fully empowered coins.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Coin Power +1 per 6 (Burn + Bleed) (max +2).
- S3 carries Unbreakable Coin — commit it when the clash strongly favors you.

**S1 — Warning Shot** (BP 4, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 4, high 12 (High / Extremely High stacked).
- Deal +10% damage for every 5 Spore on target (max 30%) ; [Before Use] At max Spore Round — Base —, inflict 1 Pierce Fragility On Hit (once per turn) ; [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Burn + Bleed) on target (max 2)
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Burn + Bleed)** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.

**S2 — E.G.O Alteration - Buckshot** (BP 4, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average / Extremely High stacked).
- Peak output requires both conditions: Deal -50% damage against sub-targets | Deal +15% damage for every 5 Spore on target (max 45%).
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition
- Spend 1 Spore Round — Buckshot —; [On Hit] Inflict +1 Burn Count
- Spend 1 Spore Round — Buckshot —; [On Hit] Inflict +2 Bleed Count

**S3 — Field Test - Dust Spark** (BP 4, CP +3, x4): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Slightly Low / Average stacked).
- Deal +50% damage for every excess Atk Weight beyond the # of actual targets (for Focused Encounters, the part) ; Deal +10% damage for every 5 Spore on target (max 30%) ; [Before Use] At 2 or fewer Spore Round — Base —, consume 6 SP to gain 3 Spore Round — Base — ; [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Burn + Bleed) on the main target (max 3) ; [On Use] If this unit has Loyalty Pheromone, Clash Power +1 ; [On Use] Convert Coins equal to Loyalty Pheromone into Unbreakable Coins, beginning with the 3rd Coin ; [On Use] At 3 Loyalty Pheromone, gain Atk Weight +1 ; [Attack End] Reload — Germination —
- **Coin Power** scales with **(Burn + Bleed)** (+1 per 6, max +3) — build stacks first.
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition

Combat passive — **E.G.O Alteration / Spore Round**: Always Active: Begin Encounters with 10 Spore Round — Base — and 6 Spore Round — Buckshot —.
  - On Hit using Coins that spend Spore Round:.
  - If Spore Round — Base — was spent, inflict 2 Spore.

Combat passive — **Spore Diffusion**: On Kill against targets that have Spore, gain the following effects:.
  - Inflict double the Spore for the next turn.
  - On Kill using a Base Attack Skill, gain (Spore Round the Skill spends / 2) Spore Round (rounded up.

Defense skill — **Evade: Spore Germination**: [Combat Start] Reload — Germination — (once per turn).
  - [On Evade Use] Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Burn + Bleed) on the attacker (max 3).
  - [On Evade] Heal 10 HP (once per turn).
  - If this unit has Loyalty Pheromone, heal an additional 5 HP for every Stack.
